source_differences: Pinned Prowler helper and Turbot SQL compare the operation/category case-sensitively. Native provider contracts compare them case-insensitively; the ten ported native predicates now follow the provider.

Strict source profiles deliberately require Global subscription-scoped declarations and direct leaves. Looser companion profiles inspect enabled operation declarations without proving subscription-wide event coverage. These profiles are not collapsed into equivalent predicates.

The service-health pair differs: the Claude source requires Incident, while the other supports a subscription-scoped ServiceHealth or ResourceHealth category and requires a resource-group inventory. Native fixtures preserve both criteria.
initial_test_construction_corrections: An initial broad test used a policy assignment operation for the administrative network/SQL profile; corrected to an actual SQL-firewall operation.
The native LIST has deciding fields, so a fabricated unused detail-GET denial is not a provider failure branch. Removed that fake expectation rather than requiring unnecessary API reads.
Resource-group path casing corrected in the finite fake router; native API accepts the actual lowercase request route.
Explicit primary-kind403 is reported as DENIED by the public engine, not renamed UNKNOWN. Both remain undecided and cannot pass.
limits: Finite native API-shaped fake transport, socket/DNS/credential construction blocked; no live Azure calls or notification actions.

This is declared configuration, not actual event delivery or full boolean alert coverage. Extra event constraints, nested anyOf and notification availability are not treated as proved subscription-wide coverage.
Strict Global-only source criteria are explicit; current valid regional storage choices are not silently treated as the same profile.
Prowler code is read at the pinned commit, never imported/executed; exact URL plus SHA256 retained, no independent Git tree attestation is claimed for these11 Python files.
